sections.name: Culture
entries: A browser fighting game that puts Nairobi-inspired characters and places at the centre of the experience.
FOR: Players who want accessible action, and creators who want African stories to be central—not background—in games.
Hii ni kazi ya ubunifu, si mwakilishi rasmi wa maeneo au jamii za Nairobi. Tunajenga kwa heshima, utafiti na nafasi ya kuboresha kwa maoni.
KWA NANI: Wachezaji wanaotaka mchezo wa action unaopatikana kirahisi na waumbaji wanaoona simulizi za Afrika zinaweza kuwa katikati ya mchezo.
Mchezo wa mapigano wa kivinjari unaoweka wahusika na maeneo yaliyochochewa na Nairobi katikati ya uzoefu.
This is creative fiction, not an official representation of Nairobi neighbourhoods or communities. It is built with respect, research, and room to improve through feedback.

sections.name: World Content
entries: Above the city, the rooftops turn movement, timing, and distance into the challenge.
CBD ni mahali pa mwendo: wasafiri, wafanyabiashara, matatu na ndoto hukutana. Katika NI MBAYA, hapa ndipo Mbavu anaanza kuthibitisha anaweza kusimama imara.
Every city has side streets where small businesses, late-night food and neighbours create their own rhythm. This chapter celebrates that everyday resilience.
From above, Nairobi looks like many stories happening at once. The rooftops remind the fighter to look beyond the next opponent and keep moving with purpose.
Juu ya jiji, paa za majengo zinageuza mwendo, muda na umbali kuwa changamoto.
Kibera inaonyeshwa hapa kama uwanja wa kubuni uliohamasishwa na nguvu ya Nairobi—si maelezo ya wakazi wake.
Kibera is presented here as a fictional fight arena inspired by Nairobi’s energy—not a statement about its residents.
Kila jiji lina mitaa ya ndani ambako biashara ndogo, chakula cha usiku na majirani huunda midundo yao. Sura hii inaadhimisha ujasiri huo wa kila siku.
Kutoka juu, Nairobi inaonekana kama simulizi nyingi zinazotokea kwa wakati mmoja. Paa za majengo zinamkumbusha mpiganaji kutazama zaidi ya mpinzani anayefuata na kusonga kwa kusudi.
Majembe is a street fighter who trusts rhythm, reach, and courage when the crowd closes in.
Majembe ni mpiganaji wa mtaani anayeamini midundo, umbali na ujasiri wakati umati unakaribia.
Mbavu is a future challenger. Defeat him to unlock his chapter in the fight.
Mbavu ni mpinzani wa baadaye. Mshinde ili kufungua sura yake kwenye pambano.
MITAA YA NDANI: MIDUNDO NA UJASIRI
Mjaka Fine fights with pace and precision—quick entries, clean exits, and no wasted movement.
Mjaka Fine hupigana kwa kasi na usahihi—anaingia haraka, anatoka safi, na hapotezi mwendo.
Nairobi CBD is the opening arena: a fast-moving city centre where the fight begins.
Nairobi CBD ndiyo uwanja wa kwanza: katikati ya jiji lenye kasi, pambano linaanza.
Sura hii ya kubuni imehamasishwa na nguvu ya Nairobi, si madai ya kuwawakilisha wakazi wake. Inaenzi wazo kwamba ubunifu na jamii vinaweza kuwa vyanzo vya nguvu.
The backstreet level narrows the space and raises the pressure as rivals close in.
The CBD is a place of motion: commuters, traders, matatus and ambition crossing paths. In NI MBAYA, it becomes the first place Mbavu proves he can hold his ground.
This fictional chapter is inspired by Nairobi energy, not a claim to represent its residents. It honours the idea that creativity and community can be powerful sources of strength.
Uwanja wa mtaa wa nyuma unabana nafasi na kuongeza presha wapinzani wanapokaribia.

sections.name: Story Content
entries: Go find Mbavu Destroyer and save your girlfriend. Ensure you teach him a lesson he will never forget.
Ili kukupunguza kasi, ametuma goons kote Nairobi kukuwinda na kukuzuia usimfikie.
Mbavu Destroyer amemteka Mjaka Mfine, mpenzi wako, na kutoweka naye katika maficho yake jijini.
Mbavu Destroyer has kidnapped Mjaka Mfine, your girlfriend, and disappeared with her into his hideout in the city.
Mtafute Mbavu Destroyer na umwokoe mpenzi wako. Hakikisha unamfundisha somo ambalo hatalisahau kamwe.
To slow you down, he has sent goons across Nairobi to hunt you and stop you from getting to him.
